usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/nano-banana-pro/generate with JSON body {prompt}; then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} (SIWX-authenticated, free) until status=="complete"
usage.outputShape: POST returns body.jobId (+ body.status=="pending"). Final image is on the status poll: body.result.imageUrl (hosted PNG on Vercel Blob storage), with body.status, body.progress, body.input.{model,imageSize,aspectRatio}, body.error.
quirks: This is an ASYNC job endpoint — the paid POST does NOT return the image. It returns {success:true, jobId, status:'pending', type:'nano-banana-pro-generate'}. You must poll for the result.

Status/result endpoint is GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} — it is SIWX-gated: returns 402 'SIWX authentication required' without SIWX, and 200 (FREE, no payment) with a SIWX signature. Poll it with SIWX until body.status=='complete' (~20s here).
Body shape is {"prompt":"..."} — NOT the Google Gemini contents/parts shape. Optional fields observed in echoed input: imageSize ('1K' default), aspectRatio ('1:1' default), model.
Final image is a hosted URL at body.result.imageUrl (PNG on *.public.blob.vercel-storage.com), NOT inline base64 — download it from there.

This stablestudio.dev backend (backendIndex 3) is a DIFFERENT proxy than the verified xona-agent.com sibling backend, which was SYNCHRONOUS and returned body.image_url directly. Do not assume sync behavior here.
usage.guide: POST to https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/nano-banana-pro/generate with a JSON body {"prompt":"<your image prompt>"} (optionally imageSize, aspectRatio). Payment is x402 USDC (~$0.13 on Base). This endpoint is ASYNC: the 200 response gives you body.jobId and status:'pending', not the image. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} using SIWX authentication (free, no extra payment; returns 402 without SIWX) every few seconds until body.status=='complete'. Read the finished image from body.result.imageUrl (a hosted PNG) and download it from there.
